note: CICS XCTL, LINK, and RETURN TRANSID edges are in docs/_work/online/navigation.json. This catalog is the middleware and file-transfer set.

interfaces.producer: MQ trigger monitor (process definition is not in this repository)
interfaces.trigger: CICS transaction started with the trigger message. CDRA starts COACCT01 (app/app-vsam-mq/csd/CRDDEMOM.csd:17-18). CDRD starts CODATE01 (app/app-vsam-mq/csd/CRDDEMOM.csd:27-28).
interfaces.message_format: Request body is moved from MQ-BUFFER to REQUEST-MESSAGE. Field order inside that buffer is not declared by an UNSTRING in these two programs.
interfaces.transactional: MQGET uses MQGMO-SYNCPOINT, MQGMO-WAIT, and a 5000 millisecond wait. CICS transaction ACTION is BACKOUT.
interfaces.error_handling: RETRIEVE response other than NORMAL performs the error paragraph and termination. MQ condition code other than MQCC-OK ends the get loop.

interfaces.trigger: After a successful MQGET on the trigger queue
interfaces.message_format: STRING into REPLY-MESSAGE, then MQPUT with MQMD-FORMAT set from MQFMT-STRING. MQMD-MSGID and MQMD-CORRELID are the identifiers saved from the request.
interfaces.transactional: MQPUT options include MQPMO-SYNCPOINT. EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT follows the open of the queues.
interfaces.error_handling: Open and put failures move the queue name into MQ-APPL-QUEUE-NAME and perform the error paragraph.

interfaces.trigger: After a successful MQGET on the trigger queue
interfaces.message_format: Same MQPUT shape as COACCT01: string reply, request MsgId and CorrelId copied onto the reply descriptor.
interfaces.transactional: MQPMO-SYNCPOINT at the put. EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT at app/app-vsam-mq/cbl/CODATE01.cbl:276.
interfaces.error_handling: Same open/put error paragraph pattern as COACCT01.

interfaces.trigger: Error path after an MQ failure
interfaces.message_format: MQPUT of the application error text. Options include MQPMO-SYNCPOINT.
interfaces.error_handling: The error queue is opened before the request loop.

interfaces.endpoint_origin: request from trigger message; reply from the request message descriptor
interfaces.message_format: UNSTRING of the get buffer DELIMITED BY ',' into date, time, card number, auth type, card expiry, message type, message source, processing code, amount, merchant category, acquirer country, POS entry mode, merchant id, merchant name, merchant city, merchant state, merchant zip, transaction id.
interfaces.transactional: MQGET is followed by IMS updates under the same CICS task. Reply queue name is MQMD-REPLYTOQ.
interfaces.error_handling: MQGET reason MQRC-NO-MSG-AVAILABLE sets no-more-message. Other reasons set an error location.

interfaces.trigger: CICS EXEC DLI SCHD, or BMP PARM on CBPAUP0J and LOADPADB
interfaces.message_format: Segments PAUTSUM0 (100) and PAUTDTL1 (200). Copybooks CIPAUSMY and CIPAUDTY.
interfaces.transactional: CICS programs schedule PSBPAUTB and TERM it when the schedule status says it was already scheduled. CBPAUP0C takes EXEC DLI CHKP. Default checkpoint counts are 5 and 10 when the parms are spaces or zero.
interfaces.error_handling: DIBSTAT is moved to IMS-RETURN-CODE. CHKP failure displays DIBSTAT. COPAUS1C issues SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK on a fraud-tagging error.

interfaces.consumer: IMS PCB from the job PARM
interfaces.endpoint: PAUDBUNL uses PSB PAUTBUNL. DBUNLDGS uses PSB DLIGSAMP.
interfaces.message_format: CBLTDLI function codes FUNC-GN and FUNC-GNP. DBUNLDGS also FUNC-ISRT.
interfaces.transactional: Checkpoint fields are declared. No CHKP call was found in these two programs.
interfaces.error_handling: Status handling is in the paragraphs that follow each CALL.

interfaces.trigger: Online transactions CTLI and CTTU, and batch job MNTTRDB2
interfaces.message_format: Columns TR_TYPE and TR_DESCRIPTION. Host include DCLTRTYP.
interfaces.transactional: COTRTUPC and COTRTLIC issue EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT after the change statements. COBTUPDT has INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE and no EXEC SQL COMMIT in the program. Plan name on the batch job is CARDDEMO.
interfaces.error_handling: SQLCODE zero is success. SQLCODE +100 is not found. SQLCODE less than zero is an error path. COTRTUPC sets a not-found flag on +100 for the SELECT.

interfaces.trigger: Batch step EXEC PGM=IKJEFT01. SYSTSIN runs DSNTEP4. SYSIN is member DB2LTCAT.
interfaces.message_format: INSERT of TRC_TYPE_CODE, TRC_TYPE_CATEGORY, TRC_CAT_DATA. Seed values stay in the control card.
interfaces.transactional: No COBOL COMMIT. The utility plan named in DB2TEP41 is DSNTEP4.

interfaces.message_format: DCLGEN include AUTHFRDS. INSERT and UPDATE of the fraud table.
interfaces.transactional: No EXEC SQL COMMIT was found in COPAUS2C. The CICS task boundary is the surrounding program.

interfaces.message_format: The WRITEQ data is the report request. The queue is defined EXTRA in the CSD. The JCL text written there is not a literal job name.
interfaces.error_handling: See the WRITEQ paragraph in CORPT00C.

interfaces.message_format: IEBGENER copy of the PDS member to the internal reader.
interfaces.error_handling: No COND is coded on STEP01.

interfaces.consumer: FTP server named on the first SYSIN record
interfaces.trigger: Job FTPJCLS. It is not named in CA7, Control-M, or the shell submit scripts.
interfaces.message_format: SYSIN command PUT of data set AWS.M2.CARDEMO.FTP.TEST to remote file welcome.txt. Mode command is ASCII.
interfaces.error_handling: User id and password are present in SYSIN and are not copied into this catalog. A comment says the job receives a file. The SYSIN command present is PUT.
interfaces.comment_confidence: The receive wording at app/jcl/FTPJCL.JCL:22 is Unverified against the PUT at line 40.

interfaces.consumer: host JES via FTP put of a jcl/ member
interfaces.endpoint: jcl member named in each put
interfaces.message_format: Ordered puts are listed in docs/_work/batch/schedule.json script_submits.
interfaces.transactional: Each put is a separate FTP transfer.
interfaces.error_handling: Remote host, user, and password are script parameters and are not copied here.

units_of_work.flow: CDRA / CDRD MQ account and date reply
units_of_work.commit: EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT after the queues are opened, and implicit end of task
units_of_work.rollback: CSD ACTION(BACKOUT) on CDRA and CDRD

units_of_work.commit: EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT after INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE
units_of_work.rollback: No SYNCPOINT ROLLBACK was found in COTRTUPC

units_of_work.commit: EXEC DLI CHKP. Default frequency 5 summary records and 10 checkpoints when the parms are empty.
units_of_work.rollback: CHKP failure displays DIBSTAT and does not issue ROLB in the paragraph read

units_of_work.commit: EXEC CICS SYNCPOINT in COACTUPC and COCRDUPC
